name: watch-my-ram
description: Warns when macOS memory pressure rises (or RAM + swap passes your threshold), lists live Claude sessions and orphan dev processes, and flags parallel test runs. Never blocks or kills.

threshold_gb.title: Memory alert threshold (GB)
threshold_gb.description: Optional. When set, the band turns red when RAM in use + swap used goes above this many GB, instead of following macOS memory pressure. Leave empty (or set 0) to follow memory pressure.
